feasibility.high_roi: One named source-scoped historical/symbolic facial-region glossary and manual observation annotation workflow; no personal trait or medical assessment from facial features.
feasibility.initial_candidate: Chinese Mian Xiang palaces/region labels from one legitimate accessible Yap/Bridges procedure,if available; otherwise a separately labeled original Lavater historical-text/plate educational scope. Do not silently replace one school with another.
feasibility.input: Prefer user-described region observations or source-schematic examples. No image pipeline or new vision dependencies in the first pass.
feasibility.resource_access: Yap/Bridges publisher metadata/contents available; full procedures and permitted examples not yet verified. Lavater original public-domain digitization available for targeted inspection.

next_requirements: Inspect one small set of original/permitted pages and illustrated examples; record printed and scan locators before rules
Freeze exact facial orientation,left/right mirroring,region labels and school/translation; no invented metric thresholds
Separate observed geometry from historical symbolic associations; no personality,criminality,health or protected-trait conclusions about a person
Retain 12-palace and five-element conventions independently; catalog inclusion does not prove the inventory provisional source mapping
Define unknown/uncertain observations and conflicting-source behavior; no arbitrary face/personality/auspiciousness scores
If photographs are later introduced,require consent,orientation and extraction validation,user corrections and minimal retention before supported use
mapping_cautions: Inventory provisionally maps five elements/12 palaces to Lavater; no evidence verified that this Western text supplies those Chinese procedures. Preserve mapping as provisional,do not borrow across traditions.

Yap marketing and historical Lavater assertions do not validate real-world inference from appearance.
